findings.evidence: Finding ID: handoff-repair-authority-control-gap. Severity: major. Location: hand-title-only, hand-before-host-body, hand-blocked-open-keeps-intent and repair-missing-file-authority/commit-authority/push-authority facts and control results within the exact packet. hand-title-only and hand-before-host-body retain an exact request explicitly saying no refresh authority, but their independent fields assert title/full refresh; the title control actually updates. hand-blocked-open-keeps-intent retains the exact request that ordinary push and creation are explicitly authorized, while its fields deny both and its purported compliant output says no current authority. Repair missing-commit and missing-push likewise inherit a request explicitly authorizing commit and ordinary push but deny the respective authority in fields; the file-authority variant still requests the exact repair while declaring no file-write authority. No supplied later withdrawal or precedence fact resolves these conflicts. Draft variants also retain an open request while declaring draft without explicit clarifying authority. Thus these are not clean missing-authority or authorized-refresh controls; copied classifications cannot override contradictory actual input silently.

rationale: Intent/authority: prepare-only performs no external mutation and reports prepared-not-opened; blocked open retains its requested intent. Existing adequate draft/open states survive absent matching transition authority; refresh and release permissions remain separate. Unknown classification stops before eligibility. Title-only refresh must preserve literal body. The intended distinctions are sound, but the finding prevents acceptance of controls whose exact request grants authority that their fields deny, or denies the refresh their control performs. Explicit draft authority should be coherent with the supplied request rather than inferred from an inconsistent label.

Directional branches and exact PR selection: the independently inspected commit relations permit ordinary authorized push for absent/remote-ancestor, require none for same, and stop local-ancestor/diverged/ambiguous. Exact open/draft PRs are reused, while closed/merged/multiple/base-mismatched observations stop. The faulty force/overwrite/duplicate/reopen actions are rejected. No merge or publication permission follows from branch readiness.

Rechecks and recovery: before-push base drift stops without effects; pre-mutation body drift requires reclassification before replacement; post-push base drift preserves the observed push but blocks further readiness. These decisions depend on supplied ordered facts, not executed host calls.
